providers.title: AI providers
providers.description: Bochica needs at least one AI provider. Paste an API key, or use a model running on this computer. Keys are stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
providers.whereToGetKey: Where do I get my key?
providers.fromEnv: Using the key from the {{name}} environment variable. Save a key here to use a different one.
providers.localDescription: Runs on this computer at {{url}}. No key needed.

result.invalid: {{provider}} rejected this key. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one.
result.network_error: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your internet connection and try again.
result.localUnreachable: {{provider}} isn't answering. Make sure it is running on this computer.
result.error: {{provider}} answered with error {{code}}. Try again in a few minutes.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This screen hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually fixes it; your keys and settings are safe.

chat.addProvider: Add an AI provider in Settings to start
chat.cutOff: The answer was cut off because it reached the length limit.

errors.missing_key: There is no API key for this provider. Add one in Settings.
errors.invalid_key: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and retry.
errors.model_not_found: This model is not available with your key. Choose another one.
errors.provider_unavailable: The provider is having problems right now. Retry in a few minutes.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and retry.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while answering. Retry, or open Details to see what happened.

docs.title: EPLAN documentation
docs.description: Sources the assistant searches before answering EPLAN questions. They are online services; nothing from your projects is sent to them except the search terms.

eplan-docs-2027.name: EPLAN Electric P8 2027
eplan-docs-2027.description: API documentation, best for exact class, action and property names.

eplan-docs-2026.name: EPLAN Electric P8 2026
eplan-docs-2026.description: API reference and user guide, searched by meaning.

eec-pro-docs.name: EPLAN EEC Pro 2026
eec-pro-docs.description: Formulas, scripting, typicals and generation in EEC Pro.

help.connected: Bochica can read and change your EPLAN projects. Every change asks you first.
help.busy: EPLAN is open but not answering, usually because a dialog is open in EPLAN. Close it and Bochica continues.
help.starting: Bochica is starting its EPLAN connection. This takes a few seconds.
help.not_configured: This copy of Bochica can't start its EPLAN connection yet. In this development version, set BOCHICA_EPLAN_MCP_DIR to an eplan-mcp folder and restart Bochica.
help.closed: Open EPLAN on this computer. Bochica connects on its own within 15 seconds.
help.unreachable: EPLAN is running but doesn't accept connections. Allow remote access in EPLAN once:
help.error: Bochica's EPLAN connection didn't start. Restart Bochica; if it keeps happening, the details below help to report it.

remoteSteps.navigate: Go to Workstation → Interfaces → Remote access.
remoteSteps.enable: Tick “Allow remote access via Remote Client” and click OK.
remoteSteps.wait: Bochica connects on its own within 15 seconds.

sessions.deleteDescription: “{{title}}” and all its messages will be deleted from this computer. Your EPLAN projects and backups are not affected.
